notes.title: Backer Beta Preview Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey Friends![/h1]
We're happy to announce that we've updated our previous closed alpha test with LOTS of new content, bug fixes, and platform support ahead of our upcoming closed beta test. This new build contains the first three levels (right about half of the full game!) for both Windows and Mac computers.

[h1]What to Test[/h1]
EVERYTHING! We've done our best to find all the nooks and crannies people can get stuck in, freezes/crashes, and all other sorts of bugs you might encounter in the game, but there are still plenty out there. Please let us know if you run into anything!

[h1]Known (Major) Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*] Frame drops (especially on the River level)
[*] Collectable UI doesn't update on pause screen (River)
[*] Music doesn't sync up in River
[/list]

Thanks so much again for all your support. And please let us know what you think!
